newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Mint tenders for 1,536,000 kg copper.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Mint tenders for 1,536,000 kg copper.

text.p: The U.S. Mint said on Tuesday it was seeking 1,536,000 kg of copper cathodes for delivery to processors in May.
Offers were due by fax by 10 a.m. EDT (1400 GMT) on April 22.
The Mint sought the copper in five lots:
-- 736,000 kg by rail in the weeks of May 19 or May 26 to Olin Corp of East Alton, Illinois.
-- 736,000 kg by rail in the weeks of May 19 or May 26 to PMX Industries of Cedar Rapids, Iowa.
-- 18,144 kg by truck in the weeks of May 19 or May 26 to Alltrista Corp of Detroit.
-- 30,856 kg by truck in the weeks of May 19 or May 26 to Alltrista Corp of Shelby, North Carolina.
-- 15,000 kg by truck in the week of May 19 to LaSalle Rolling Mills of Carrollton, Georgia.
